title: Vendor credit lookup offers an inactive part with a grey Inactive tag
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, with vendor A.
  • Have an active part, part B, with vendor A.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on vendor A's page (Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then the vendor A row).
custom_steps:
1. Click the button that starts a new vendor credit.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the credit's Part Number field.
  3. Click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A new vendor credit for vendor A opens.

Step 2:

  • Parts A and B are offered.
  • Part A carries a grey "Inactive" tag beside its description; part B has no tag.

Step 3:

  • Part A fills the credit line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R11: “Part lookup on a vendor return and on a vendor credit includes inactive parts.”
  • S9-R12: “In those lookups an inactive part carries a grey "Inactive" tag beside its description.”
